metadata.title: Heirs' Property Training (Webinar from DBAN)
metadata.author: Farm Aid
metadata.shortDescription:
Annette Hiatt and Mary Henderson are senior staff attorneys with the Land Loss Prevention Project in North Carolina, where they provide direct legal services to farmers and landowners. In this training, they will discuss what heir property (or heirs' property) is, its historical context, how it affects farmers and other landowners, and how to assist folks who are dealing with it.

For more information, please visit https://farmaid.org/DBAN

Farm Aid's mission is to build a vibrant, family farm-centered system of agriculture in America. Farm Aid artists and board members Willie Nelson, Neil Young, John Mellencamp, Dave Matthews and Margo Price host an annual festival to raise funds to support Farm Aid's work with family farmers and to inspire people to choose family farm food. Since 1985, Farm Aid, with the support of the artists who contribute their performances each year, has raised more than $85 million to support programs that help farmers thrive, expand the reach of the Good Food Movement, take action to change the dominant system of industrial agriculture and promote food from family farms.

In addition, any reference to specific brands or types of products or services does not constitute or imply an endorsement by the U.S. Department of Agriculture for those products or services.
